resource.name: email-service
resource.description: Sends transactional email notifications: an employee is notified when their claim is approved or rejected, and a manager is notified when a new claim awaits their approval.

suggestions.name: SendGrid
suggestions.description: Widely used transactional email API with generous free tier.

suggestions.name: Amazon SES
suggestions.description: Low-cost email sending, natural fit if already on AWS.

suggestions.name: Postmark
suggestions.description: Transactional-email specialist known for high deliverability.
